.env.debug.name: Debug defaults
.env.debug.description: Sets development defaults for the local preview, such as the built-in admin login and relaxed sign-in rules.

.env.example.name: Settings template
.env.example.description: Lists every setting a real installation needs, with comments, so an operator can copy and fill it in.

.env.test.example.name: Test settings template
.env.test.example.description: Lists the settings the automatic test environment expects, without any real secrets.

.vscode/launch.json.name: Debug launch setups
.vscode/launch.json.description: Defines ready-made debugging configurations for editors opened on this workspace.

.vscode/settings.json.name: Editor settings
.vscode/settings.json.description: Sets workspace-wide editor preferences used while working on this project.

.vscode/tasks.json.name: Editor task shortcuts
.vscode/tasks.json.description: Adds one-click commands for starting, stopping and restarting the local stack.

api/.coveragerc.name: Coverage settings
api/.coveragerc.description: Tells the coverage tool which server files to measure and which to ignore.

api/alembic.ini.name: Database change settings
api/alembic.ini.description: Points the database change tool at its scripts and the connection details it should use.

api/pyproject.toml.name: Server tool settings
api/pyproject.toml.description: Configures the code formatter, linter and type checker for the server code.

api/pyrightconfig.json.name: Type checker setup
api/pyrightconfig.json.description: Tells the server type checker where the code lives and how strict to be.

api/pytest.ini.name: Test runner settings
api/pytest.ini.description: Sets how the server's automatic checks are discovered, marked and reported.

client/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json.name: Web app dev container
client/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json.description: Prepares a coding environment for working on the screens with the tools they need.

client/.env.example.name: Web app settings template
client/.env.example.description: Lists the settings the browser app build can read, such as where the server lives.

client/.github/workflows/azure-static-we.name: Legacy web hosting deploy
client/.github/workflows/azure-static-we.description: An older workflow that published the web app to Azure static hosting and is kept only for reference.

client/.github/workflows/release.yml.name: Web app release
client/.github/workflows/release.yml.description: Builds the browser app bundle and publishes it when a version is released.

client/.prettierrc.name: Formatting preferences
client/.prettierrc.description: Sets the code formatting rules applied to the web app's files.

client/components.json.name: Screen block config
client/components.json.description: Tells the building-block generator where shared screen parts live and how to name them.

client/manual-verify/solutions-deployed-.name: Deployed Solutions check
client/manual-verify/solutions-deployed-.description: A by-hand script that inspects installed Solutions in a live environment and never runs automatically.

client/manual-verify/solutions-live-veri.name: Live Solutions check
client/manual-verify/solutions-live-veri.description: A by-hand script that exercises Solutions against a running server to confirm behaviour.

client/package.json.name: Web app dependencies
client/package.json.description: Lists the libraries the browser app uses and the commands that build, test and check it.

client/public/fonts/fonts.css.name: Typeface definitions
client/public/fonts/fonts.css.description: Declares the custom typefaces and weights the screens use so text renders consistently.

client/tsconfig.app.json.name: Web app compile settings
client/tsconfig.app.json.description: Sets how the browser app's code is compiled for production.

client/tsconfig.json.name: Root compile settings
client/tsconfig.json.description: Points the editor and build tools at the main compile settings for the screens.

client/tsconfig.node.json.name: Build tool compile settings
client/tsconfig.node.json.description: Sets compile rules for the scripts that build and serve the browser app.

debug.sh.name: Local preview launcher
debug.sh.description: Starts, stops and inspects a private copy of the platform for one working folder, with its own login.

Initialize-Bifrost.ps1.name: Windows setup script
Initialize-Bifrost.ps1.description: Prepares a Windows machine for a first run: creates the settings file with fresh secrets and starts the stack.

pyproject.toml.name: Project dependencies
pyproject.toml.description: Lists the Python packages the platform needs and the settings its checks use.

setup.sh.name: First-time setup
setup.sh.description: Creates the settings file with secure random passwords and the web address for a new installation.

test.sh.name: Test runner
test.sh.description: Starts an isolated set of containers and runs the automatic server, screen and browser checks.
